## Legs: run vs queued

### Engineering legs — RAN (offline only)

- `db/src/db/data/subject_entity_types.toml` + `db/src/db/subject_types.py`
  — the committed, versioned (`1.0.0`) subject-scheme → entity-type
  map: 28 family prefixes declared, each type validated against
  `vocab_entity_type` (`KNOWN_ENTITY_TYPES` mirrors the seed, pinned by
  test), longest-prefix match, `UnmappedSubjectScheme` on any value the
  map does not cover. Non-claim record kinds (`agenda_document`,
  `portal_document`, `registry_query_meta`, `*_artifact`,
  `tenant_api_error`) are deliberately unmapped — reaching the mint
  path is a refusal, never a guess.
- `db/src/db/claim_sink.py` — the `_DEFAULT_ENTITY_TYPE` broad mint is
  gone: `_insert_claim` resolves `subject_type` through
  `self._subject_typer` (default `entity_type_for_subject`; injectable
  for plumbing fixtures) **before** run/evidence/entity minting, and an
  unmapped value quarantines `unknown_subject_scheme` with the full
  payload. A `sig.connector.subject` `object_ref` must declare the
  type the map declares — an unmapped or disagreeing ref quarantines
  the same way; non-subject object refs keep their declared type.
  `_Staged.subject_type` feeds `_write_chunk`'s refs tuple so the
  identity guard receives the mapped type.
- `db/src/db/assertion.py` — `UNKNOWN_SUBJECT_SCHEME =
  "unknown_subject_scheme"` joins `QuarantineReason`.
- `ops/src/ops/seed.py` — the seed's organization projection resolves
  each subject through the same map + `resolve_identity_batch` (per-
  subject type, never a hardcoded `organization` for all).
- `connectors/src/connectors/flock_portal.py` — `_portal_partner_ref`
  types portal partner object refs via `entity_type_for_subject`
  (`flock_portal:` → `data_system`), identical to the same identifier
  minted as a subject.
- `db/src/db/typed_identity.py` + `sig-db typed-identity` — the
  append-only correction: `plan_decisions` reads
  `entity_identity_key`, reports per-type pending corrections and
  unmapped subjects (reported, never typed); `apply_decisions`
  `INSERT`s `entity_type_decision` rows `ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING` —
  +0 on rerun; `--apply` is the only write path. `prior_type` records
  the effective type superseded; `map_version` stamps `1.0.0`.
- sqitch `entity_typing_mobility_check` (deploy/revert/verify + plan

  domain_entities entity_identity_key]`, real `date -u` stamp
